title: hex_digit uses (b'0' + nibble) as char: char::from is more idiomatic
description: blob.rs:99-104: hex_digit does (b'0' + nibble) as char and (b'A' + nibble - 10) as char. Both are safe because nibble is 0-15 (match arms) and results are < 128. char::from(b'0' + nibble) is more idiomatic and communicates the intent without relying on the reader knowing the as-cast semantics. Not a bug.
